extracted.name: Stuffed braided bread
ingredient_lines: 1 cup mix veggies for stuffing(cabbage,corn, onions, tomatoes)
instruction_lines: In bowl add water,sugar and yeast keep aside for ten minutes.in bowl add all-purpose flour put yeast mixture, mix and Knead dough keep aside for 2 hours.
Heat Pan add oil.add oil once hot put onion saute. Add all veggies mix well.add red chilli sauce,dark soya sauce,salt,red chilli powder.mix well cook for five minutes.allow it to cool down.
Knead dough again.divide into pieces. Roll oval shaped give cuts like fins of fish.put cooled veggies mixture in middle part

Put grated paneer,as I didn't get cheese.fold it putting cross.heat kadai put sand in bottom preheat for ten minutes.put bread in greased mould. Put in kadai and bake for 30 minutes. Serve hot with tomato sauce.
